title: Step 5: Calling checkWinner() and checkDraw() Methods

blocks.content: Step 5: Calling checkWinner() and checkDraw() Methods

items: Added code to call checkWinner() and checkDraw() methods from inside the play() method of the Game class.

blocks.content: Each time after a user enters a position, we have called the checkWinner() method to see if a player won or not. If a player won the game, we have used the break statement to end the while loop.
Similarly, we have called the checkDraw() method each time after the board is updated and if the winning condition is not met.
Please run this code to see if it's working as expected or not.
Next, we will add a few try catch statements in our code to handle exceptions and complete the project.
